title: Ikholwa Elifihliwe
intro: Ezindlini zamandla ezicebile, lapho ukungakholwa nobushiqela kwakubusa khona, izwi elilodwa leqiniso lakhuluma livela endaweni engalindelekile. Lo muntu waphonsela inselelo igunya lokuvikela isithunywa, ebeka ukuphepha kwakhe engozini ukuze amemezele iqiniso.
clues: Ngangihlala ezweni elinobushiqela obukhulu, ngikhonza umbusi owayethi unguNkulunkulu.
Ngagcina izinkolelo zami zeqiniso zifihliwe iminyaka eminingi, ngesaba imiphumela yokuziveza.
Lapho kufika isithunywa nezibonakaliso ezicacile, ngakholwa, kodwa abantu bami bamenzela ugobe.
Ngema phambi kombusi nomkhandlu wakhe, ngiphikisana ngokuthi akufanele babulale isithunywa esingenacala.
Ngabaxwayisa ngesijeziso sezizwe zesikhathi esidlule ezalahla iqiniso, njengabantu bakaNowa no-'Ad.
U-Allah wangisindisa emacebweni abo amabi, futhi ngabona ukubhujiswa kombuso ocindezelayo.
arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
